'''Kara Via''' wrote a report on the rescue of [[Basal Moor]] from [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]] headquarters on [[Pako Ramoon]] by the [[Xi'Dec/Legends|Xi'Dec]] extraction agents [[K'lial Khzrry|K'lial]] and [[Diskio Khzrry]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] attached the report to the dossier on the Khzrrys he included in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''.
